title: Increase BlueFire logo size across all locations

requirements.summary: Increase BlueFire logo size in Header component from 40px to 64px
acceptanceCriteria: Logo in header navigation displays at 64px width and height
Logo maintains aspect ratio and visual quality at larger size
Logo remains properly aligned with the company name text

file_operations.description: Update the img element's width and height attributes from 40px to 64px in the Header component. Maintain existing logo positioning, alignment with the brand name text, and all other styling properties. The logo image file path and source location remain unchanged.

requirements.summary: Increase BlueFire logo size in HeroSection component from 48px to 80px
acceptanceCriteria: Logo in hero section displays at 80px width and height
Logo remains properly positioned within the badge container
Logo maintains visual hierarchy with the company name and tagline

file_operations.description: Update the img element's width and height attributes from 48px to 80px in the badge section of the HeroSection component. Preserve the logo's positioning within the badge container, maintain visual hierarchy with the company name and tagline, and keep all other styling and layout properties unchanged.

requirements.summary: Increase BlueFire logo size in Footer component from 32px to 56px
acceptanceCriteria: Logo in footer displays at 56px width and height
Logo maintains proper alignment with surrounding footer content
Footer layout remains balanced with the larger logo size

file_operations.description: Update the img element's width and height attributes from 32px to 56px in the Footer component. Maintain proper alignment with surrounding footer content, preserve the balanced footer layout, and keep all other styling properties unchanged. Do not modify the logo image file path or source location.
